name: Lightbringer's Promise
source:
In a cursed world, you set foot into the role of a young adult, with loving grandparents, your best friend, a fox spirit Husheng, and yet... Your peaceful life gets shaken up as you witness the sky break, and a Lightbringer, a celestial being, fall out of the sky.

You've always been warned about those creatures, and your grandparents strictly prohibited contact with them, but her life is in your hands now.

Will you save her, Wenjin, or will you stay clear, and let her succumb to her destiny, killed by the embodiment of evil?

[From [url=https://xionsol.itch.io/lightbringers-promise]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一个受到诅咒的世界里，你将扮演一名刚刚成年的年轻人，身边有慈爱的祖父母与挚友狐妖胡生相伴。然而……当你亲眼目睹苍穹碎裂、一位名为“携光者”的天界生灵从天而降时，平静的日常顿时被彻底打破。

你从小便听惯了关于这类生灵的警告，祖父母更是严令禁止你与她们有任何接触——可如今，她的性命就攥在你的手中。

你究竟会出手救下文瑾，还是明哲保身袖手旁观，任由她屈从宿命、惨死于邪恶化身的毒手之下？

[摘自[url=https://xionsol.itch.io/lightbringers-promise]itch.io[/url]]
